There's a very large market for games that specifically do not encourage you to play for longer than 5-10 mins at a time. I've got hours invested into the vault I used for footage to make this video and my average session is right around the 5 minute mark. People who have coffee breaks, or wait for city transit, or have a few minutes to kill while they wait for the water in the kettle to boil for tea...all tend to get good use out of casual games that are truly casual. The people who tried to play Fallout Shelter like a PC or console game...> 15 mins at a time and "bored" when they ran out of things to do...those are the ones who missed out. It's not a failing of the game. It's a matter of the players recognizing what the game is suited for.
